_note: v2.8 plan 23 (no model): clue wall, map, clock and a story-made HTML panel in player mode. Hidden clue, link and pin never reach the snapshot or the page; the HTML panel opens in a sandboxed frame and its bridge logs ui/initialize; with story-made panels off the plain wall shows and a clue's action fills the box (never sends); a deleted message takes the reached pin and the found clue back. Every write is a /cp set boundary. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-23-widgets.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return true;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: false, presence: { ...rt.getSnapshot().ui.presence, widgets: true, htmlWidgets: true } }); const ids = () => (rt.getSnapshot().game?.widgets ?? []).map((w) => w.id); const leaks = () => ['SO-HIDDEN-CLUE-TEXT', 'SO-HIDDEN-LINK', 'SO-HIDDEN-PIN', 'secret_found', 'found_ledger'].filter((needle) => JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().game ?? {}).includes(needle)); globalThis.__w23 = { ids, leaks }; return true;

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin The harbour smells of tar and wet rope.

steps.eval: const w = globalThis.__w23; const got = w.ids(); if (JSON.stringify(got) !== JSON.stringify(['river', 'alarm-clock'])) throw new Error('player panels before anything is found: ' + JSON.stringify(got)); if (w.leaks().length) throw new Error('leak: ' + w.leaks()); return got;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); const w = globalThis.__w23; const got = w.ids(); if (JSON.stringify(got) !== JSON.stringify(['river', 'alarm-clock', 'board'])) throw new Error('player panels after the ledger: ' + JSON.stringify(got)); const board = rt.getSnapshot().game.widgets.find((x) => x.id === 'board'); const clues = board.body.source.body.clues.map((c) => c.text); if (JSON.stringify(clues) !== JSON.stringify(['A torn ledger page, signed M.'])) throw new Error('board view: ' + JSON.stringify(clues)); if (w.leaks().length) throw new Error('leak: ' + w.leaks()); return clues;

globalThis.storyOrchestratorWidgetBridge?.clear?.(); const opener = document.querySelector('#so-open-widgets'); if (!opener) throw new Error('no story panels opener (#so-open-widgets)'); if (opener.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') opener.click(); let frame = null; for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !frame; i += 1) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); frame = document.querySelector('#so-widget-board iframe[data-so="html-widget"]'); } if (!frame) throw new Error('the HTML panel did not open a frame'); if (frame.getAttribute('sandbox') !== 'allow-scripts') throw new Error('sandbox: ' + frame.getAttribute('sandbox')); let audit = []; for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !audit.some((e) => e.method === 'ui/initialize' && e.outcome === 'ok'); i += 1) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); audit = globalThis.storyOrchestratorWidgetBridge?.audit?.() ?? []; } if (!audit.some((e) => e.method === 'ui/initialize' && e.outcome === 'ok')) throw new Error('the frame never initialized over the bridge: ' + JSON.stringify(audit)); const map = document.querySelector('#so-widget-river')?.textContent ?? ''; if (!map.includes('The harbour') || map.includes('SO-HIDDEN-PIN')) throw new Error('map panel: ' + map); if (document.body.textContent.includes('SO-HIDDEN')) throw new Error('a hidden item is in the page'); return { audit: audit.map((e) => e.method + ':' + e.outcome) };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ presence: { ...rt.getSnapshot().ui.presence, htmlWidgets: false } }); let fallback = null; for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !fallback; i += 1) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); fallback = document.querySelector('#so-widget-board [data-so="html-fallback"]'); } if (!fallback) throw new Error('with story-made panels off the plain wall did not show'); if (document.querySelector('#so-widget-board iframe')) throw new Error('the frame stayed with story-made panels off'); const box = document.querySelector('#send_textarea'); box.value = ''; fallback.querySelector('[data-so="widget-action"]').click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200)); if (box.value !== 'I show the ledger page to Arin.') throw new Error('the clue action did not fill the box: ' + JSON.stringify(box.value)); const sent = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.some((m) => m.mes === box.value); box.value = ''; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); rt.setUiSettings({ presence: { ...rt.getSnapshot().ui.presence, htmlWidgets: true } }); if (sent) throw new Error('the action sent a message'); return true;

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); const river = rt.getSnapshot().game.widgets.find((x) => x.id === 'river'); const pins = river.body.pins.map((p) => p.label + (p.here ? '*' : '') + (p.fresh ? '+' : '')); if (JSON.stringify(pins) !== JSON.stringify(['The harbour', 'The dock*+'])) throw new Error('pins after the dock: ' + JSON.stringify(pins)); const board = rt.getSnapshot().game.widgets.find((x) => x.id === 'board'); if (board.body.source.body.links.length !== 1) throw new Error('links: ' + JSON.stringify(board.body.source.body.links)); if (globalThis.__w23.leaks().length) throw new Error('leak: ' + globalThis.__w23.leaks()); return pins;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); await ctx.deleteMessage(ctx.chat.length - 1, undefined, false); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; let now = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i += 1) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); now = JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().game?.widgets); if (now === globalThis.__w23.before) break; } if (now !== globalThis.__w23.before) throw new Error('the panels did not revert with the deleted message: ' + now.slice(0, 400)); return true;

for (const close of document.querySelectorAll('#so-panels-root [data-so="panel-close"]')) close.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); return document.querySelectorAll('#so-panels-root [data-so="widget-panel"]').length === 0;
